interpretation_notes.stake: Flat sizing is min(requested_stake, current available bankroll), not percent-cap sizing. Raw 3% and 5% each had one partially funded bet.
interpretation_notes.source_revision: Current run_nba_sweep.py and sweep_runner.py differ from the recorded hashes. Scoped live diff is logging/progress and safe acquisition-error detail; do not claim current source is byte-identical to the executed snapshot.
interpretation_notes.under_slice: Under-only totals are post-hoc slices of the saved selected bets, not a new policy replay that could choose alternative bets.
